records.name: resting
records.prompt: Edit reference1 Tarçın fox illustration, using reference2 as immutable character identity and reference3 as approved matte gouache style. Preserve exact pose, facial expression, number/position of limbs, fur colors/markings, white muzzle/chest/tailtip, brown eyes and dark plum paws. REMOVE all painted ground patches, cast shadows, loose paint beyond fur and glow/halos. Every pixel outside physical fox silhouette must be transparent. No props, scenery or lettering. Opaque fox fur, narrow natural antialias edge. Do not redesign or add anatomy. This is a clean isolated cutout for white and dark reader backgrounds.
